mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM notification_rule
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_rule (rule_id, display_name, enabled, event_type, plugin_id, job_id, severity, channel_ids_json, remark, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{displayName}, #{enabled}, #{eventType}, #{pluginId}, #{jobId}, #{severity}, CAST(#{channelIdsJson} AS JSON), #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification_rule WHERE enabled = TRUE AND event_type = #{eventType} AND (plugin_id = '' OR plugin_id = #{pluginId}) AND (job_id = '' OR job_id = #{jobId}) AND (severity = '' OR severity = #{severity}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN plugin_id <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, CASE WHEN job_id <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, CASE WHEN severity <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, id ASC
